title: The Wheel of Fortune: Spinning as Famine Relief
version: Spinning as Famine Relief, Young India 11 May 1921
lineage: Paraphrased research notes, not a source copy.

passages.locator: Spinning as Famine Relief, Young India 11 May 1921
passages.note: The published account describes spinning at Miri near Ahmednagar, with wheels lent due to poverty and made by local carpenters. It reports two Rs 100 donations, six annas per pound and 29 wheels running. These are project claims, not independently audited general wages or famine outcomes.
